principle: No result, failure, retained finding or period exposure may exist only in conversation context. Scientific work is blocked until canonical memory has been loaded and acknowledged.

M0_load_canonical_research_memory.blocker: Any missing mandatory file, ambiguous pointer or stale registry blocks scientific interpretation.

required_checks: latest candidate registry is the manifest pointer
registry state matches completed binding evidence
current period permissions match period policy
technical incomplete attempts are separated from scientific results
Actions artifacts are identified by run_id artifact_id digest created_at and corresponding Release receipt when archived
historical errata are explicitly recorded rather than silently corrected

search_dimensions: shock extension acceptance retention overlap recovery and event-state features
automatic_rejection: same closed exact rule with changed threshold
proposal omits a contrary H2 or 2025 result
proposal cites only headline net or PF and omits failed gates
proposal uses protected-period outcomes for selection

hypothesis_lifecycle.historical_entry_edit_rule: append errata or superseding entry; never silently rewrite

result_reporting_additional_required_fie: which prediction was confirmed or contradicted
why the result failed even when headline metrics improved
whether failure is mechanism scope parameter-identifiability concentration execution lineage or period-regime related

same_research_change_required: period access ledger or policy pointer

current_period_boundary.2023: descriptive baseline and Architecture Atlas work authorized as declared in current registry
current_period_boundary.2024_H1: historical development evidence; do not mutate existing lineage
current_period_boundary.2024_H2: locked unless current registry explicitly authorizes
current_period_boundary.2025_H1: known adverse gate evidence; no retuning or threshold selection
